document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The river batters your craft from every side. No matter which 
way you turn, it gets worse. The canoe bucks like a saddled 
buffalo, bounding over sets of snaggling rapids. You eye peaks 
and teeth that could tear out the belly of your craft.
Make a Pilot (Boat) roll: if you succeed, go to 6; if you fail, go to 7.
